payload.command:
set -e
printf 'PWD=%s\n' "$PWD"
for x in qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-i386 telnet nc socat timeout; do command -v "$x" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s=%s\n' "$x" "$(command -v "$x")" || true; done
ls -l /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
